failure_if_out_of_range: PTO shaft bottoms out or separates during operation
repair_actions: Place Rotavator on a firm level surface and adjust depth control equipment until the Gearbox Input Shaft is horizontal.
Position tractor at a distance from the Rotavator to ensure a minimum of 150 mm (6 inches) engagement of the male half of the PTO shaft in the female tube.
embedding_text: Pto Drive Shaft clearance 150 mm PTO shaft bottoms out or separates during operation

failure_if_out_of_range: PTO shaft exceeds maximum operating angle
repair_actions: Attach PTO Drive Shaft to tractor ensuring quick release pin engages spline shaft groove.
Attach stabiliser bar or check chains to limit sway to 50 mm (2”).
Lift Rotavator until PTO Drive Shaft attains an angle of 40o and set limit stop on hydraulic lift control quadrant.
